title: Evento de governança: one line of the append-only, hash-chained log
description: evento:n. prev is the sha256 of the previous line's canonical JSON (64 zeros for the first). Actions: propose, correct, review, approve, reject, dispute, adjudicate, invalidate. approve, reject, dispute and adjudicate require a reason; approve and adjudicate require a pessoa (invariant 4); a product_rule proposed by a pessoa with a reason is her decision and is settled on record (DECISIONS D22); a review names its verdict and independence. assertion_type regra is a reading of the law: it is never human_approved and settles when a blind reviewer of another family upholds it (invariant 5). product_rule is how a person's product decision enters the log (invariant 12). The replay (engine/governance.py) enforces every rule again.

assertion.description: The id the event is about (a regra, link, adaptador, product rule slug, veredicto, disputa...).

expected_revision.description: For review/correct/approve/reject: the exact revision answered; stale revisions cannot be reviewed.

question.description: For review: the exact question answered, showing every value proposed.
